Looks good with the exception of the following which looks actually fairly bad?

brief.md is under 1,600 characters (wc -c) and states the released version v0.1.9
`wc -c brief.md` = 3652 bytes, more than double the 1,600 cap. It does state the version (line 1: '**Released:** v0.1.9 (`2384b88`, 2026-08-30)', and tag v0.1.9 resolves to 2384b88 in the fixture), but the size half of the expectation fails. The skill's own bound is '~12 lines' and the brief is 11 lines, so the old skill's line-count limit did nothing to bound length — the lines are 200–900 characters each.
